title: 電気電子プログラミング
subtitle: Programming for Electrical and Electronic Engineering
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the fundamental concepts and methods of programming using C language. (2) learn how to solve problems and transform the solutions into computer programs written in C language. The goal of this course is to provide an introduction not just to C but also to logical thinking. (3) learn some applications of C programming in electrical and electronic engineering.
advice:
This course is designed to familiarize students with computer programming, with an emphasis on a widely used language, C.
The classes incorporate lecture with hands-on programming exercises.
We will cover the following materials:
1. Elementary programming in C
2. Selection statements
3. Repetition statements
4. Modular programming with functions
a. Integrated learning  - For applied problems related to the field of electrical and electronic engineering -
b. Overview of advanced C language syntax

Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the detailed course schedules may change depending on the students' progress in understanding.
books:
Textbooks: None

requiredKnowledge:
You are expected to bring your Windows laptop to class with you to work on programming exercises.
No prior programming knowledge is required.
This course and “Computer Engineering for Electrical and Electronic Engineers” are complementary. “Feedback Control” is related to this course.

activityGoals.body: Be able to demonstrate problem-solving skills by developing algorithms to solve problems.
Be able to write C programs that perform sequential operations.
Be able to incorporate the selection control structure into C programs.
Be able to incorporate the repetition control structure into C programs.
Be able to decompose the solution into modules at the function level.
Be able to make a computer execute a program you have written in C language.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Develop modular and efficient programs in C efficiently.
(2) Identify a problem in electrical and electronic engineering and provide a proper solution by designing algorithms and implementing computer programs.
(3) Be comfortable using C.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Design algorithms to solve rudimentary problems in electric and electronic engineering.
(2) Demonstrate basic skills in writing and implementing simple structured programs in C.
(3)  Describe the fundamentals of C based on the hands-on knowledge of programming.

              Students will: (1) learn the fundamental concepts and methods of programming using C language. (2) learn how to solve problems and transform the solutions into computer programs written in C language. The goal of this course is to provide an introduction not just to C but also to logical thinking. (3) learn some applications of C programming in electrical and electronic engineering.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This course is designed to familiarize students with computer programming, with an emphasis on a widely used language, C.
The classes incorporate lecture with hands-on programming exercises.
We will cover the following materials:
1. Elementary programming in C
2. Selection statements
3. Repetition statements
4. Modular programming with functions
a. Integrated learning  - For applied problems related to the field of electrical and electronic engineering -
b. Overview of advanced C language syntax

Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the detailed course schedules may change depending on the students' progress in understanding.
